name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Generated by the Launchbed tooling/github-actions addon.
# JDK and SDK package IDs come from docs/compatibility.md via the generator.
jobs:
  android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
          cache: gradle
      - uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
      - name: Install SDK packages
        run: sdkmanager "platforms;android-{{compileSdkPackage}}" "build-tools;{{buildToolsVersion}}" "platform-tools"
      - name: Unit tests
        run: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest
      - name: Assemble debug APK
        run: ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
      - name: Lint
        run: ./gradlew :app:lintDebug
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: app-debug
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
